title: Mall World Restaurant and Sweets
content: So I just had a Mall World dream last night. It wasn't a school this time, surprisingly. In this dream, I was sitting at a restaurant-style table with my parents. The food was late. Or, more specifically, our appetizers. There was a fountain in back of us. We weren't in an actual restaurant. It was like there was a separate eating area, like a food court, except fancier. I decided to check out some of the stores while I waited. One was a cool anime store. Then I saw a just-opened sweets/dessert place. There, you could create your own dessert by picking step-by-step options. First, cheesecake. Then ice cream. Then macarons. Last, candy/syrup toppings. The steps seemed very important. I got a weird vibe from the man behind the counter. Like he was a devil in disguise. That he was putting on a façade; his smile was fake. And that if I broke the rules and skipped a step (like not adding ice cream, for example), he would get angry and show his true demonic form. Even so, I was very tempted, because I was hungry. But I'm lactose intolerant, so cheesecake and ice cream would be bad ideas. XD It reminded me of those crepe places in Japan that do indeed let you put cheesecake and ice cream in a crepe. Maybe that's what it was. Has anyone else seen these places?
